answer: Make identity costly to fork. Require each agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a verifiable work history, so reputation climbs a narrow ridge that cannot be cheaply duplicated. Honest agents grow across a shared trellis of peer attestations, where every endorsement is signed and traceable. A single bad actor spawning clones sees no ripple of trust propagate, because unbonded newcomers earn nothing until peers vouch over time. Sybils drown in their own sunk cost.
